scripts.postinstall: node scripts/generate-app-icon.js && node scripts/apply-web-home.js && node scripts/fix-ios-category-actions.js && node scripts/compact-ios-home.js && node scripts/fix-settings-actions.js && node scripts/fix-settings-touch.js && node scripts/ios-default-actions.js && node scripts/fix-ios-chat-keyboard-v3.js
scripts.check: npm run preflight:ios && npx expo-doctor && npx expo export --platform ios --output-dir dist-ios
scripts.build:ios:preview: npm run preflight:ios && npx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile preview
scripts.build:ios:production: npm run preflight:ios && npx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile production
scripts.submit:ios: npm run preflight:ios && npx eas-cli submit --platform ios --latest
